model_annotation: The bar chart depicts the number of people who visited the central, southern and northern cities in Spain annually from 2013 to 2021. Each bar represents a year, and the height of the bar corresponds to the number of visitors. The chart uses different colors to distinguish between the central (blue), southern (orange), and northern (gray) cities. The data is presented on a linear scale, and the vertical axis represents the number of people, starting from 0 and increasing in increments of 200 up to 1200. The horizontal axis lists the years from 2013 to 2021. The values for each city and year are not specified in the question.
